card.name: Numbers just before 'to' in dose ranges
card.fires_on: The last digit of a number that starts a range, right before 'to' and a second number with mg or mL. It appears in dose tables and dosing text.

modes.label: Range start in doses
modes.description: A digit that opens a numeric dose range, such as 1 to 3 mg.
modes.example: respond to a cumulative dose of <<1>> mg to 3 mg of Flum

modes.label: Final digit of round numbers
modes.description: The trailing 0 of numbers like 100, 300 or 600 in dose-range tables.

modes.label: Odd case in capitals
modes.description: A rare hit on the ending of a word in all-caps text, outside dosing.
modes.example: FOR EVERY 3 SODI<<UM>>S INSIDE THE CELL IS EXCH
